mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2.5% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during periods of FEDFUNDS < 2% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k jobs per month, the labor market's dual indicators signal economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances meeting the dual labor market trigger.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.2% MoM signals a supply chain rebound, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $500B YoY indicates strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of quarters with RSAFS YoY growth > $750B.

mechanism_narrative: A FEDFUNDS rate increase of more than 50bps in a single meeting signals a hawkish monetary policy shift, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 50bps in a single meeting
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns following a > 50bps FEDFUNDS hike are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises above 5% and PAYEMS growth falls below 100k jobs per month, the labor market's dual indicators signal economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances meeting the dual labor market trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in HOUST of more than 10% YoY signals weakening housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
